about: The /chat page's lines (GitHub #13250, compliance plan step C9): what GET /api/chat/state answers an admin, text, one line each, cells split by "|", every line ended by a line end. SQL writes them (chat.lines in coax/web/api/migrations/0139_chat_folders_tabs.sql; chat.v and chat.vv in 0021_chat.sql) and coax/web/api/chat.c sends the text as it is. components/zeron/chat-lines.coax is the one reader, and the writer in Coax; the page apps/openagents-web/chat.coax reads every line through it. "lines" names each kind and its cells in order: "col" is the cell's column (the kind's letter is column 0) and "text" says how the cell is written. "answers" are bodies a running API gave the API suite (coax/web/api/test_zchat.py, a throwaway database and a stand-in runner), byte for byte. components/zeron/chat-lines-profile.coax reads every line through the codec and writes the same bytes back.
captured: 2026-11-13: the API suite's /chat step (coax/web/api/test_zchat.py) against a running oa-api of this tree, each answer recorded as sent. The keys, tokens and hashes in them are the suite's stand-ins.

text.plain: a number, a flag, a date or a word the API chooses; it holds no bar and no line end
text.clean: a short text with each bar, tab, carriage return and line end written as a space (SQL chat.v; chl_clean)
text.escaped: a long text: a backslash is written \\, a bar \p, a line end \n; a carriage return is dropped and a tab is two spaces (SQL chat.vv; chl_escape, undone by chl_unescape)

order: Z, then every C, then S when a conversation is shown, then each U followed by its T lines. Z's shown is S's id, or 0 when there is no S.
older: An API before migration 0139 writes Z with no record cell and C with no folder or tab. The reader gives an empty cell for a column a line lacks, and the page reads an empty record as no folders and no tabs. No fixture holds such an answer: no running API writes one.
not_held: No captured answer has a bar or a backslash in a message or an answer, so \p and \\ appear in no fixture line. The codec's own tests cover them with made-up text (coax/bin/coax test components/zeron/chat-lines.coax --library).

lines.says: the head: one, the first line

fields.name: spent
fields.says: today's spend on OpenAgents' key for /chat, dollars with two decimals

fields.name: cap
fields.says: the day's cap, the same way

fields.name: credential
fields.says: the asker's saved credential's kind: api, oauth, or empty for none

fields.name: last4
fields.says: the saved credential's last four characters, or empty

fields.name: expired
fields.says: 1 when the saved credential has expired, else 0

fields.name: busy
fields.says: 1 when a turn of the conversation shown waits or runs, else 0

fields.name: shown
fields.says: the id of the conversation shown, or 0 for none

fields.name: record
fields.says: 2: the API keeps folders and tabs (migration 0139)

lines.says: a conversation: the asker's 60 newest and every open tab, newest first

fields.name: id
fields.says: the conversation's number

fields.name: title
fields.says: its title, at most 80 characters; empty until it has one

fields.name: model
fields.says: the model its next turn uses

fields.name: updated
fields.says: when it last changed: Mon DD HH24:MI, Chicago time

fields.name: busy
fields.says: 1 when a turn of it waits or runs, else 0

fields.name: folder
fields.says: the folder its turns read

fields.name: tab
fields.says: its place among the open tabs, from 1; empty when its tab is closed

lines.says: the conversation shown: none or one, after the C lines

fields.name: id
fields.says: the conversation's number: Z's shown

fields.name: title
fields.says: its title, as on its C line

fields.name: model
fields.says: the model its next turn uses

fields.name: resumes
fields.says: 1 once a turn of it has started, else 0

lines.says: a turn of the conversation shown: its 40 newest, oldest first

fields.name: id
fields.says: the turn's number

fields.name: status
fields.says: queued, running, done, failed, stopped or refused

fields.name: at
fields.says: when it was asked, written as C's updated

fields.name: model
fields.says: the model it ran on

fields.name: credential
fields.says: whose key it ran on: openagents or own; empty until it starts

fields.name: text
fields.says: the message, at most 8000 characters

fields.name: answer
fields.says: the answer, at most 24000 characters; empty until there is one

fields.name: error
fields.says: why it failed, at most 400 characters; else empty

fields.name: working
fields.says: what a running turn is doing, at most 160 characters; else empty

fields.name: cost
fields.says: what it cost, dollars with four decimals

lines.example: U|9|running|Nov 13 01:45|claude-opus-5-5|own|with my token|||getting the latest code|0.0000

lines.says: a tool the turn used: its 12 newest, each after its U line

fields.name: turn
fields.says: the U line's id

fields.name: name
fields.says: the tool's name, at most 40 characters

fields.name: detail
fields.says: what it was used on, at most 200 characters; may be empty
